questions.question: How long is a password valid before it expires?

top.text:
# Password and Account Security

## Password rules

Passwords must be at least 14 characters and contain three of the four categories: uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols. Passwords expire every 180 days. You will receive reminder emails at 14, 7, and 1 day before expiry. A password cannot match any of your previous 12 passwords. Passphrases such as four unrelated words are allowed and encouraged because they are easier to remember and harder to guess than short complex strings.
top.label: 02/Password rules

top.text:
## Changing your password

### On Windows

1. Press Ctrl+Alt+Delete.
2. Choose Change a password.
3. Enter the old password, then the new password twice.
4. Lock and unlock the laptop once so cached credentials refresh. If you skip this step, Outlook and Teams will keep prompting with the old password for up to an hour.

### On macOS

## Locked account

An account locks after five failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes. The lock clears automatically after 30 minutes. If you need access sooner, go to the self-service password portal, choose Unlock account, and enter the one-time code sent to your registered phone. If your registered phone is not available, the helpdesk can unlock your account after verifying your identity with your employee id and manager's name.

## Multi-factor authentication

### Authentication loop

If the client keeps asking for your password after you have entered it correctly, your account may be locked. Use the self-service password portal to unlock it, wait five minutes, then try again.

## Regional gateways

## Phishing

Never enter your password on a page you reached from an email link. The real sign-in page always shows the company logo and the address ends in example.com. Report suspicious emails with the Report Phishing button in Outlook. Do not forward them. If you did enter your password on a suspicious page, change it immediately using the steps above and inform the security team the same day.

## Adding a printer

### Windows

1. Open Settings, then Bluetooth and devices, then Printers and scanners.
2. Click Add device, wait ten seconds, then click Add manually.
3. Choose Add a printer using an IP address or hostname.
4. Enter the IP address from the label. Leave the port name as suggested.
5. When asked for a driver, choose the generic PCL6 driver. Do not download a manufacturer driver; the generic one is faster and is the only one the print server supports.
6. Print a test page.

## Finding your printer

Every office printer has a label on the front with its name and IP address. Printer names follow the pattern SITE-FLOOR-NUMBER, for example AUS-02-03 is the third printer on the second floor in Austin. Always add printers by IP address rather than by name. Name-based discovery depends on a directory service that is often slow and sometimes lists printers that have been retired.

questions.question: When are OS updates pushed and how long do I have to restart?

top.text:
# Laptop Performance and Updates

## Update policy

Operating system updates are pushed on the second Tuesday of each month. You will see a notification with a seven-day window to restart at a convenient time. After seven days the laptop restarts automatically outside working hours. Security patches rated critical may be pushed outside this schedule with a 24-hour window.

## Slow after an update
top.label: 04/Update policy

top.text: After a major update the laptop rebuilds its search index and scans files for the security agent. This takes between 30 and 90 minutes depending on how much data is on the disk, and the laptop will feel sluggish during that period. The fix is patience plus two restarts: restart once immediately after the update finishes, then again an hour later. If the laptop is still slow the following day, file a ticket and include a screenshot of Task Manager or Activity Monitor sorted by CPU.
5. Wait for the status to show Connected. The first connection downloads a configuration profile and can take up to two minutes.

Before filing a ticket, check these in order:

1. How many browser tabs are open. More than 40 tabs is the most common cause of slowness we see.
2. Whether the disk is more than 90 percent full. Empty the Downloads folder and the Recycle Bin or Trash.
3. How long since the last full restart. Sleeping the laptop for two weeks is not a restart. Shut it down fully once a week.
4. Whether a backup or sync is running. The cloud drive client shows a progress indicator in the system tray or menu bar.

## Fans running constantly

Usually the security agent or a stuck browser tab. Restart first. If the fans run loud at idle for more than a day after a restart, file a ticket; the fan may be clogged with dust and Facilities can clean it.

# Software Requests and Policy

## Installing software

Standard users cannot install software directly. This is deliberate. Open the Software Center on Windows or Self Service on macOS and search for the application. If it is listed, click Install and it will be set up within a few minutes without needing administrator rights. The catalogue includes browsers, PDF tools, developer tools, and the standard office suite.

## Requesting software not in the catalogue

## Open source

Open source libraries for development are not restricted. Open source desktop applications go through the normal request process, usually on the fast track.

For installers that genuinely need administrator rights, you can request a 60-minute elevation through the Admin Request tool. Your manager receives an approval prompt. Elevations are logged and audited. Do not use elevation to install software that was rejected in a request; this is a policy violation.

## Connecting for the first time

1. Open the VPN client from the Start menu on Windows or the Applications folder on macOS.
2. Enter the gateway address shown on your onboarding card. Do not use a gateway from another region; it will connect but be slow.
3. Sign in with your work email and password.
4. Approve the push notification on your registered phone. If you do not receive it within 30 seconds, open the authenticator app and use the six-digit code instead.

## Browser extensions

Extensions are controlled by an allow list. If an extension is blocked, request it through the same process as software. Ad blockers are allowed. Extensions that read page content on every site, such as grammar checkers, require a security review.

## Temporary administrator rights

For installers that genuinely need administrator rights, you can request a 60-minute elevation through the Admin Request tool. Your manager receives an approval prompt. Elevations are logged and audited. Do not use elevation to install software that was rejected in a request; this is a policy violation.

## Open source

Open source libraries for development are not restricted. Open source desktop applications go through the normal request process, usually on the fast track.

# Software Requests and Policy

## Installing software

Standard users cannot install software directly. This is deliberate. Open the Software Center on Windows or Self Service on macOS and search for the application. If it is listed, click Install and it will be set up within a few minutes without needing administrator rights. The catalogue includes browsers, PDF tools, developer tools, and the standard office suite.
